text:
sarah-support: FYI customer acme-inc (ticket ACME-1191) reporting rerank p95 spikes and gateway 502/504s under load starting 2026-03-15 ~14:12 UTC. They saw p95 > 6s and a bunch of timeouts. Payloads are large (avg ~1.1MB) and they batch ~200 candidates per request.

olivia-support: Repro steps from customer pasted below. They run a loop at ~120 qps: `POST /v1/rerank` with `candidates: 200`, `context_len: 512`. They included `X-Request-ID: 01ARZ3...` samples.

olivia-support: sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"..."}],"candidates":[/*200 items*/]}'
```

ben-sre: I pulled infra metrics for the window. Gateway p95 for /v1/rerank jumped from ~180ms -> 3.8s, and pod-side 5xxs spiked ~14:14 UTC. We see retry loops in the gateway: upstream 502 -> gateway retries -> pile up.

ben-sre: logs snippet (gateway):
```
[14:14:12] request_id=01ARZ3... upstream_status=502 attempt=1
[14:14:12] request_id=01ARZ3... upstream_status=502 attempt=2
[14:14:12] request_id=01ARZ3... upstream_status=502 attempt=3 -> dropped
```

ryan-runtime: Thanks. Two likely contributors: (1) large batch sizes + heavy KV cache miss rate causing long backend decode time; (2) gateway retry policy + high concurrency creating retry storm. Customer batch=200 is high for rerank — our recommended default is 32-64 depending on model.

ryan-runtime: Questions: can we get a sample request payload (anonymized) and an `X-Trace-ID` for one of the failed requests? Also which model variant are they routing to (quantized vs fp16)?

olivia-support: Sent payload + header bundle to the thread DM. Sample trace id: `trace-9a7c`. Customer says model=redwood-rerank-1.0 (default).

ricardo-eng: I pulled traces for `trace-9a7c`. Backend CPU on the rerank pool shows a few requests with tokenization/attention steps taking ~2.9s each, and KV cache lookups falling back (miss-rate ~38%). Also seeing GC pauses around the same time on a couple of pods.

jen-oncall: Immediate mitigations I pushed at 14:30 UTC: 1) tightened gateway retry policy for rerank to max_retries=1 and exponential backoff; 2) temporarily route heavy requests (payload>500kB or candidates>100) to a dedicated, lower-QPS pool with more headroom; 3) added a 5xx circuit-open threshold to fail fast.

ben-sre: After the mitigation, p95 dropped to ~420ms and 5xx rate decreased ~80% for the next 20m. However, we still saw a few stragglers when customer ramped back to 120 qps.

ryan-runtime: Root causes (hypothesis): large batches causing long per-request backend latency (KV cache thrash + GC) + gateway retries amplifying load. Action items:
- request: olivia/support to ask customer to reduce batch size to 50 and retry test
- eng-runtime (ryan/ricardo): investigate GC tuning and KV prefetch heuristics for rerank pools; add telemetry to surface candidate count & payload size per request in traces
- eng-sre (ben): validate retry/backoff config and test a circuit-breaker more aggressive threshold in staging

sarah-support: I'll relay the ask to the customer and request a staged test at lower QPS. Can you confirm ETA for KV/GC investigation?

ricardo-eng: I'll dig in today and follow up by EOD UTC with two small experiments: 1) enable async KV prefetch for large candidate lists; 2) bump heap soft limits to reduce GC frequency for the affected pod class.

ryan-runtime: I'll also add a quick flag in staging to log candidate_count & payload_bytes in the trace root so we can correlate with p95 within hours.

jen-oncall: For communication to the customer: short note that we've implemented temporary routing+retry changes and recommend lowering batch size to 50 while we tune infra. I'll draft a message. :white_check_mark:

sarah-support: Perfect — please tag me when the customer test starts. We'll mark ACME-1191 as 'engineering active' and coordinate a follow-up after the staged run. Thanks all. :pray:
